canvas: sprites are exact archive decodes on their original canvases (typically 100x100); blit top-left at cell_screen_point + hotspot

sprites.source_file: IWWLS3C.PNG (mirrored stand-in; archive IWWLS7A is burned outdoor art, IWWLS7C missing)
SWINS27A.PNG (user import; replaces empty archive 8SWINS7A decode)

under_image_rule: Map tiles may carry an Image1 property naming a floor sprite to draw beneath the wall at that cell (original engine mechanism; e.g. LIHW->WFLO, WWAR/WWAQ/SWAQ/SWAR->SFL5). Draw Image1 first, then the wall. For wall cells without Image1 that neighbour interior floors, the half-diamond adjacency underlay applies (renderer rule).
